name: Shinozaki Marika
source: [url=/c21481]Ryousuke's[/url] childhood friend, the two were reunited when he moved back to Shionagi. When Marika was young she would often take days off class because of asthma attacks, and was often kept company by Ryousuke. When he had to move, she promised him to get better for when they meet again, and is very happy that she has managed to keep this promise.
